title: Litter Box Hideaway Ideas: 9 Spots That Cut the Smell (and the Ones Cats Refuse to Use)
excerpt: Hide the litter box without losing the cat: 9 hideaway spots compared, how many boxes you need, why your cat needs a view and an exit, and the daily habit that actually controls the smell.
meta_description: Litter box hideaway ideas cats will use: 9 spots compared, one box per cat plus one, a view and an exit, and daily scooping to control the smell.
